meta.title: Whispers From Distant Stars
meta.description: The embers of hope drift across a forsaken expanse of desolation.

units.displayText: Hubble, would you like to take part in the construction of the Jiutian sector during the beta phase of Project Neural Cloud? I think you'd like it very much.

spans.text: Jiutian sector? Is it a sector that simulates outer space?

units.rawText: Yup. While we can't go into space in reality because of the Collapse Particle clouds, we can still create a universe within our reach on the cloud server.

units.rawText: Currently, communications for Haumea Observatory are being disrupted, so I am unable to contact other observation facilities. However, I can use the observatory's system to help you locate them.

units.rawText: Thank goodness, at least we won't have to look for a needle in a haystack now.

units.rawText: The exterior environment is fairly dangerous. Please follow me to the observatory's data center.
units.displayText: The exterior environment is fairly dangerous. Please follow me to the observatory's data center.

spans.text: The exterior environment is fairly dangerous. Please follow me to the observatory's data center.

units.displayText: One month ago, Haumea Observatory detected an irregular signal from the Kuiper Belt. Then, a cometary fragment impacted Haumea.

units.rawText: Affirmative. The impact location was very far from the observatory. Apart from a few surveillance devices on the surface of Haumea, the base was not severely affected.
units.displayText: Affirmative. The impact location was very far from the observatory. Apart from a few surveillance devices on the surface of Haumea, the base was not severely affected.

units.rawText: However, one day later, the region impacted by the fragment began to mutate. Haumea Observatory fell under attack. Currently, 55% of the observatory has been destroyed. The other agents from the observatory have withdrawn to Jupiter for safety.
units.displayText: However, one day later, the region impacted by the fragment began to mutate. Haumea Observatory fell under attack. Currently, 55% of the observatory has been destroyed. The other agents from the observatory have withdrawn to Jupiter for safety.

units.displayText: A comet... So these monsters came on a comet? Do you know what they are?

spans.text: A comet... So these monsters came on a comet? Do you know what they are?

units.displayText: The two members of the Neural Cloud sector are...

units.rawText: We've found them! That's Xinghuan and Yuwang's signal... Solar system, Saturn... Is it coming from somewhere near Titan?

units.rawText: But what about you, Belka? You just said all your friends have already evacuated; doesn't that mean you're in great danger if you're here all by yourself?
units.displayText: But what about you, Belka? You just said all your friends have already evacuated; doesn't that mean you're in great danger if you're here all by yourself?

spans.text: But what about you, Belka? You just said all your friends have already evacuated; doesn't that mean you're in great danger if you're here all by yourself?

units.displayText: My motive systems have malfunctioned. I did not want to become a burden to my comrades.

spans.text: My motive systems have malfunctioned. I did not want to become a burden to my comrades.

units.rawText: I successfully ensured the withdrawal of my colleagues. Currently, I am protecting the data that remains.
units.displayText: I successfully ensured the withdrawal of my colleagues. Currently, I am protecting the data that remains.

spans.text: I successfully ensured the withdrawal of my colleagues. Currently, I am protecting the data that remains.

units.displayText: ...So you volunteered to stay behind... to protect the data?

spans.text: Affirmative. The research data has been evacuated, but many colleagues were unable to do so and have perished. Their data is saved on the core data terminal.

units.displayText: After a final keystroke, Belka raises its ruined body and hands over a data terminal.

units.displayText: Hubble accepts the terminal Belka hands her.
